body.message:
Good morning Liss,

Thank you for your interest in this apartment.

Before proceeding with the booking, we would be happy to arrange a viewing for you. Please note that viewings can only be arranged between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM, as the building management does not allow viewings after 6:00 PM.

Kindly let us know your preferred viewing time.

Also, may I know how many months you are looking to book for? Once confirmed, I can share the full quotation with you.

Thank you, and we look forward to hearing from you.
